title: Leerlingbegeleiding 1982
authors: Hardus, H., Ubbo Emmius, lerarenopleiding * Groningen (primary investigator)
contributors: Hardus, H.Ubbo Emmius lerarenopleiding * Groningen (research initiator)
descriptions: Investigation of a possible connection between problems of pupils and coaching of pupils. Data on size and organization of school / coaching of pupils by school and by external institutions / organization of stimulating activities and institutions / problems experienced by pupils concerning school life, parents, health, sexuality, self-confidence, future etc.. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education
